  <h1>Occam SEO is an SEO agency based in Apex, North Carolina, offering technical SEO, local SEO, SEO content writing, comprehensive SEO audits, and website design and  development for small and mid-sized businesses. Occam SEO LLC serves clients in the Raleigh–Durham Triangle and beyond. SEO services are billed hourly; audits and new websites are fixed-fee. </h1>
